author: _Mx_
body:
Minecraft username:
_Mx_


Time period when I was banned:
March 10th, 2015. 3:38:31 PM GMT. Client Modifications.


Why I should be unbanned:
I'm not going to bother lying and saying I wasn't using hacks - I was. I can't go back and fix that. If this means instant denial, at least I get the satisfaction of being honest. 
I've spent almost a year now regretting using blacklisted modifications on this server, and there was no excuse for them. I don't know why I did it. But I made a solid resolution after I was banned on this server to never use blacklisted modifications ever again. And proudly I can say I haven't. I've served a lengthy period of time being banned, thinking about what I've done, and thought now would be a good time to make an appeal. I am requesting to be unbanned because I have truthfully learnt my lesson. I changed a lot since then. I've become staff on several servers, and have matured. I understand that this will both take a long time to be reviewed and it may not be accepted, but thank you if you read this. 
I'm seriously sorry.

Yours Sincerely,
_Mx_
